title: Petdex: Animated pets for your coding agents
description: Petdex is the public gallery of animated pets for coding agents. Works with ChatGPT (Codex), Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode. Browse open-source pets, preview their animations, and install one with a single command.
